sections.title: 3. Purposes and legal bases for processing

blocks.text: We process data for the following purposes:

3.1. Waitlist management
We process data to add you to the waitlist, send Fishki development updates and notify you about the application launch.

Legal basis: consent or the Controller's legitimate interest in serving people interested in the product.

3.2. Preorder management
We process data to accept and fulfil the preorder purchase, send confirmation, provide application access and handle refunds and complaints.

Legal basis: performance of a contract or steps taken before entering into a contract.

3.3. Product communication
We process data to send information about development, tests, surveys, feature voting and Fishki updates.

Legal basis: consent or the Controller's legitimate interest where communication concerns a product in which the user has previously shown interest.

3.4. Marketing
With your consent, we may send marketing information about Fishki, promotions, special offers and new features.

Legal basis: consent. You may withdraw consent at any time.

3.5. Analytics and website improvement
We may analyse website use to improve its operation, measure content effectiveness and develop the product.

Legal basis: the Controller's legitimate interest or consent where required for cookies or similar technologies.

3.6. Establishing, pursuing or defending claims
We may process data to establish, pursue or defend claims.

Legal basis: the Controller's legitimate interest.

3.7. Accounting and tax obligations
For preorder purchases, we may process data required for accounting and tax settlements.

Legal basis: a legal obligation incumbent on the Controller.
